description: This file contains a Jupyter Notebook demonstrating how to use the 'litellm' Python package to calculate costs for various language model completion calls across different providers such as OpenAI, Together, and Replicate. It includes code cells for installing the package, making completion requests, and computing associated costs.

methods.name: completion
methods.description: Performs a language model completion given a specified model and messages.

methods.name: completion_cost
methods.description: Calculates the cost of a completion response based on token usage.
